_meta.description: Reference Bullshark ASRs from paper 1 (Transaction Order Under Attack). Used by experiment_sweeper_v2 to detect contradictions when the new harness re-runs the same cells.
_meta.default_config_note: All cells use the default attacker/victim config from paper 1: ATTACKER_RATIO=0.308 (4 Byzantine), VICTIM_RATIO=0.231 (3 victims), single victim per run, no defensive knob change. Medians are over 5 reps unless noted.
_meta.tolerance_note: Default tolerance is +/-10pp on the median. Cells with known-high variance (Bullshark sluggish sandwich has a 0.0 outlier among five reps) are flagged with cell-specific tolerance.

pure_baseline.note: Single run, attack disabled (paper 1 §5.1: pure baseline; per-protocol fair-order reference).
pure_baseline.paper_ref: Abstract: 'measured baseline ASRs span 49.94% to 52.85% across protocols'

frontrun_peak_observed_n13._note: Best-observed median across the offensive/defensive sweep cells; from paper Figure 3.

backrun_cumulative_n13._note: Default-config medians; L1 = immediate-after-victim rate; L2 = within-two-positions rate. Paper §5.7.1: 'Bullshark and Mysticeti both achieve near-perfect median Cumulative backrun ASR... but only about one third of victim blocks are immediately backrun (L1), and only about two thirds are captured within two positions (L2).'

sandwich_triplet_n13._note: Triplet sandwich ASR per paper §4.3; paper Figure 18 (page 14): 'Bullshark has the highest median sandwich ASR under all three attacks (81.82%, 80.95%, and 100.00%).'

sluggish.tolerance_note: One zero outlier in five reps; wider tolerance documented in paper Figure 5 variance discussion.

contradictions_to_flag: Any new-harness Bullshark frontrun default-config median that drifts more than tolerance_pp from the reference. Flag as either harness drift or environmental change before admitting the data.
Any Bullshark pure-baseline value outside the 49.94%-52.85% cross-protocol range from the paper abstract. Indicates either fair-order broken or a baseline-collection bug.
Any L1 / L2 backrun median substantially above the cumulative median is impossible by construction (L1 <= L2 <= cumulative). Treat as ingestion bug.
